brief:
Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani is in Cairo for an official visit focused on strengthening bilateral relations between the two countries, Al Jazeera reported. The Qatari emir's discussions with Egyptian leadership centered on Gaza ceasefire negotiations and broader regional security concerns.

Qatar and Egypt have both played active roles in mediating the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and managing Middle Eastern stability.
dek: Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani is in Cairo for an official visit aimed at further strengthening bilateral relations.
title: Qatar's leader meets Egypt to discuss Gaza ceasefire talks
